ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a composite figure composed of a rectangle on the left and a semicircle on the right. The height of the rectangle is labeled 14 cm, and the bottom from the left side of the rectangle to the pink dashed line is labeled 20 cm. The pink dashed line is the right boundary of the rectangle and is also the diameter of the semicircle on the right. Reasoning: The area of the rectangle is 20 × 14 = 280 square centimeters. The diameter of the semicircle is 14 cm, so the radius is 7 cm. The area of the semicircle is (1/2)π(7^2) = 24.5π ≈ 77.0 square centimeters. The total area is 280 + 77.0 ≈ 357.0 square centimeters. Rounded to the nearest tenth, it is 357.0.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a composite of a rectangle and a semicircle: the left rectangular part is labeled 20 cm long and 14 cm high, and the dashed vertical line at the right edge of the rectangle is the diameter of the attached semicircle. Compute the rectangle area as 20 × 14. Use the 14 cm diameter to get semicircle radius 7 cm, then compute the semicircle area as (1/2)π(7^2). Add the two areas and round to the nearest tenth, giving about 357.0.
